message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to current air‑quality data, so I can’t tell you the exact AQI for Los Angeles right now. For the most up‑to‑date information you can check:

- **AirNow** (airnow.gov) – provides the latest AQI values for cities across the U.S.  
- **EPA’s Air Quality Index app** – available on iOS and Android.  
- **Local news outlets** (e.g., LA Times, KABC) often report on smog levels.  
- **Weather apps** (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather) usually include an AQI indicator.

If you’re looking for a quick snapshot, just search “Los Angeles AQI” in your browser or open one of the apps above.
